descriptionFr: Gite d etape au village de Catastaghju (Serra di Fiumorbu). Demi-pension possible, 20 places.
descriptionEn: Guesthouse in the village of Catastaghju (Serra di Fiumorbu). Half-board available, 20 beds.

descriptionFr: Point d eau potable en bord de sentier, dernier ravitaillement avant la montee.
descriptionEn: Drinking water point along the trail, last supply before the climb.

descriptionFr: Vue degagee sur la plaine orientale et la mer Tyrrhenienne depuis le col.
descriptionEn: Open view over the eastern plain and the Tyrrhenian Sea from the pass.

descriptionFr: Anciennes bergeries en pierre, temoins de la vie pastorale corse. Source a proximite.
descriptionEn: Ancient stone sheepfolds, witnesses of Corsican pastoral life. Spring nearby.

descriptionFr: Traversee d une magnifique foret de pins laricio, espece endemique corse pouvant atteindre 50m.
descriptionEn: Walk through a magnificent Laricio pine forest, endemic Corsican species reaching up to 50m.

descriptionFr: Petit commerce de ravitaillement au village. Pain frais, charcuterie corse, fromage.
descriptionEn: Small supply shop in the village. Fresh bread, Corsican charcuterie, cheese.

descriptionFr: Gite d etape au coeur du village, 16 places. Cuisine commune, demi-pension.
descriptionEn: Guesthouse in the heart of the village, 16 beds. Shared kitchen, half-board.

descriptionFr: Sources d eau chaude naturelles sulfureuses, connues depuis l Antiquite. Baignade possible.
descriptionEn: Natural sulphurous hot springs, known since Antiquity. Bathing possible in natural pools.

descriptionFr: Gite d etape pres des thermes, 18 places. Cadre paisible en bordure de torrent.
descriptionEn: Guesthouse near the thermal springs, 18 beds. Peaceful setting by the stream.

descriptionFr: Source d eau potable le long du sentier entre Cozzano et Guitera. Debit regulier.
descriptionEn: Drinking water spring along the trail between Cozzano and Guitera. Regular flow.

descriptionFr: Fontaine villageoise, eau potable fraiche. Dernier point d eau avant le col.
descriptionEn: Village fountain, fresh drinking water. Last water point before the pass.

descriptionFr: Col a 1193m d altitude entre Guitera et Zicavo. Panorama sur les deux vallees.
descriptionEn: Mountain pass at 1193m between Guitera and Zicavo. Panoramic views of both valleys.

descriptionFr: Epicerie du village avec produits locaux. Ravitaillement possible, horaires restreints.
descriptionEn: Village grocery with local products. Supplies available, limited hours.

descriptionFr: Traversee de chataigneraies centenaires, arbre emblematique de la Corse interieure.
descriptionEn: Walk through centuries-old chestnut groves, emblematic tree of inland Corsica.

nameFr: Panorama de la vallee du Taravo
descriptionFr: Point de vue exceptionnel sur la vallee du Taravo et les montagnes environnantes.
descriptionEn: Exceptional viewpoint over the Taravo valley and surrounding mountains.

descriptionFr: Bergerie traditionnelle en pierre sur le sentier. Fromage de brebis en saison.
descriptionEn: Traditional stone sheepfold on the trail. Sheep cheese in season.

descriptionFr: Gite d etape dans le village de Bastelica. Vue sur le Monte Renoso, 22 places.
descriptionEn: Guesthouse in the village of Bastelica. View of Monte Renoso, 22 beds.

descriptionFr: Source d eau potable pres du sentier, en contrebas de la bergerie de Tolla.
descriptionEn: Drinking water spring near the trail, below the Tolla sheepfold.

descriptionFr: Vue panoramique sur le golfe d Ajaccio et les iles Sanguinaires en fin de parcours.
descriptionEn: Panoramic view over the Gulf of Ajaccio and the Sanguinaires Islands near the end.

descriptionFr: Arrivee du sentier Mare a Mare Centre sur la plage de Porticcio, face au golfe d Ajaccio.
descriptionEn: Mare a Mare Centre trail arrival at Porticcio beach, facing the Gulf of Ajaccio.
